title: Move Statements into Function

solutions.title: One shared total, computed once
solutions.tradeoff: The receipt builder now owns a business rule its callers used to own individually, so a future exception for one caller has nowhere to live but a parameter or a branch.

reviewFocus: Before the merge, did every caller's copy of the total computation actually agree, or did the reprintReceipt copy get folded in without anyone checking?
Is the credit-clamp fix committed separately from the mechanical move, or are a behavior change and a refactoring sitting in the same diff?
Did renderReceipt's parameter list actually shrink, or is totalCents still being threaded through out of caution?
Do the three callers' own trailing lines still live on the callers, or did one of them creep into the shared function along with the total?
Would this same reasoning - fold it in once everyone agrees - already have failed if one caller's difference had been a real, wanted difference rather than a bug? Compare against drill-08-04.
